chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and Aban ibn Taghlb was with him. So I said, 'May Allah improve your state.' Indeed, my daughter died and my mother is alive.' So Aban said, 'There is nothing for your mother.' So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Glory be to Allah! Give her the one-sixth.'
ai.seo_question: What is the mother's share of inheritance when the deceased has a daughter?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the scholarly method of *ijtihad* in the presence of the Imam, where Aban ibn Taghlib initially applied a general rule but was corrected by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to the specific ruling of one-sixth. It underscores the authority of the Imam in clarifying inheritance laws, particularly regarding the mother's share when the deceased leaves a daughter, a scenario governed by the interplay of Quranic verses and juristic deduction. The incident serves as a practical lesson in how early Shia scholars engaged with the Imams to refine legal understanding.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, said,

‘I came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence was Aban Bin Taghlub. So I said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you well! My daughter died and my mother is alive’. So Aban said, ‘There is nothing for your mother’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Give her the one-sixth!’
en.sarwar: 15. Afi ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Sa‘d ibn abu Khalaf from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu ‘Abd Allah who has narrated the following: “I once visited abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when Aban ibn Taghlib was with him (the Imam) and I said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep you well, my daughter has died and my mother is alive.’
Aban said, ‘There is nothing for your mother.’ Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘Allah is free of all defects, give her one-sixth.’”
